panels.title: Do we need to optimize?
1 · Computer DO contention: DO time per batch and write, Slack wait busy − quiet (p95)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, if(event_name = 'sessionlog.append', 'DO time per journal batch p95', 'DO time per API write p95') AS metric, quantile(0.95)(if(event_name = 'sessionlog.append', JSONExtractInt(data, 'do_ack_ms'), JSONExtractInt(data, 'do_ms'))) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.append', 'computer.write') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE (event_name = 'sessionlog.append' AND JSONHas(data, 'do_ack_ms')) OR (event_name = 'computer.write' AND JSONHas(data, 'do_ms')) GROUP BY time, metric
UNION ALL
SELECT toStartOfHour(occurred_at) AS time, if(event_name = 'dispatch.sent', 'Slack dispatch wait p95: busy − quiet (hourly)', 'K1 p95: busy − quiet (hourly)') AS metric,
  if(countIf(busy) > 0 AND countIf(NOT busy) > 0, quantileIf(0.95)(ms, busy) - quantileIf(0.95)(ms, NOT busy), NULL) AS value
FROM (SELECT occurred_at, event_name, if(event_name = 'dispatch.sent', JSONExtractInt(data, 'wait_ms'), toInt64(duration_ms)) AS ms,
  (org_id, toStartOfMinute(occurred_at)) IN (SELECT DISTINCT org_id, toStartOfMinute(occurred_at) FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.append') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE org_id != '') AS busy FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('dispatch.sent', 'ack.done') AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY event_id))
GROUP BY time, metric
) ORDER BY time

panels.description: Optimize the Computer DO when any line stays above 100 ms (n ≥ 50 batches, 20 writes, 20 dispatches per side over 3 h; the same verdict: Tinybird `optimize_checks`). Why 100 ms: the host flushes a streaming session's journal every 100 ms, so a DO that spends 100 ms or more on each batch (`do_ack_ms`: frame received → ack sent) or API write (`do_ms`) is handling them back to back and starts to queue everything else, including Slack. The busy − quiet lines are the direct test: p95 Slack dispatch wait (`dispatch.sent` wait_ms) and K1 in org-minutes when journal batches reached that org's DO, minus minutes when none did, per hour (both sides need samples in the hour); 100 ms (K1: 100 ms) is 10% of the K1 budget (1 s). Caveat: Workers clocks stand still during synchronous code, so do_* counts awaits (storage, the SessionLog RPC, the per-session chain), not CPU; DO CPU is Cloudflare's GraphQL analytics (the manual CPU check in the 084 instrumentation answers). Busy ms per org-minute (threshold 30000) and the span breakdown are in the DO load row below.

panels.title: 2 · SessionLog: append and commit lag p95

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, 'SessionLog append p95 (append_ms)' AS metric, quantile(0.95)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'append_ms')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.append') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE JSONExtractString(data, 'refused') = '' GROUP BY time, metric
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, 'commit lag p95: host sent → journal-ack (commit_ms)' AS metric, quantile(0.95)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'commit_ms')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('mirror.ack') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE 1 GROUP BY time, metric
) ORDER BY time

panels.description: Optimize the SessionLog append path when either line stays above 200 ms (n ≥ 50 over 3 h; commit uses 200 ms). Why: 200 ms is two 100 ms flush windows. While an append takes longer than that, the host has the next batch ready before the last one is acknowledged, so batches pile up per session and every API reader and wire client sees events late. `append_ms` is the DO → SessionLog round trip (refused appends excluded); `commit_ms` is the host's view: oldest covered batch sent → journal-ack received.

panels.title: 3 · Slack K2/K3 warm p95: v4 runners ÷ v3 (3 h buckets)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(sent_at, INTERVAL 3 HOUR) AS time, if(countIf(first_visible_ms IS NOT NULL AND v4) >= 30 AND countIf(first_visible_ms IS NOT NULL AND NOT v4) >= 30, quantileIf(0.95)(first_visible_ms, v4) / greatest(quantileIf(0.95)(first_visible_ms, NOT v4), 1), NULL) AS `K2 v4 ÷ v3`, if(countIf(overhead_ms IS NOT NULL AND v4) >= 30 AND countIf(overhead_ms IS NOT NULL AND NOT v4) >= 30, quantileIf(0.95)(overhead_ms, v4) / greatest(quantileIf(0.95)(overhead_ms, NOT v4), 1), NULL) AS `K3 v4 ÷ v3`
FROM (SELECT t.sent_at AS sent_at, t.first_visible_ms AS first_visible_ms, t.overhead_ms AS overhead_ms, p.protocol IN ('v4', 'v4+client') AS v4
FROM (SELECT * FROM turns WHERE $__timeFilter(sent_at) AND surface = 'slack' AND path = 'warm' AND outcome != 'silent' AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY turn_id) AS t LEFT JOIN (SELECT turn_id, trace_id, multiIf(JSONExtractUInt(data, 'host_protocol') = 4 AND JSONExtractUInt(data, 'api_clients') > 0, 'v4+client', JSONExtractUInt(data, 'host_protocol') = 4, 'v4', 'v3') AS protocol FROM calvin_events WHERE event_name = 'turn.started' AND turn_id != '' AND occurred_at >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND occurred_at < $__toTime + INTERVAL 1 HOUR LIMIT 1 BY turn_id) AS p ON p.turn_id = t.turn_id) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Optimize the runner's v4 path when a ratio stays above 1.2 (each side needs 30 warm Slack turns in the bucket; the rules check 24 h). Why 1.2, not 1.0: v3 and v4 runners are different hosts and orgs, so some spread is population, not 084. The deploy-regression rule allows 1.3× and CI perf-check fails at 1.5× p50; 1.2 catches a smaller shift earlier. Above it, confirm causally with the same-org before/after check (rollout step 3 in the 084 instrumentation answers). The per-protocol K1-K6 detail, with an attached client split out, is on Calvin · Speed and the `slack_by_protocol` endpoint.

panels.title: 4 · Runner journaling on the hot path: runner wrote → host sent, urgent batches (p95)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, 'urgent batches: newest event age at send p95' AS metric, quantile(0.95)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'newest_age_ms')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('mirror.batch') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE JSONExtractBool(data, 'urgent') GROUP BY time, metric
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, 'flushed batches: oldest event age at send p95' AS metric, quantile(0.95)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'oldest_age_ms')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('mirror.batch') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE NOT JSONExtractBool(data, 'urgent') GROUP BY time, metric
) ORDER BY time

panels.description: Optimize the runner's journal writer when the urgent line stays above 50 ms (n ≥ 50 over 3 h). Urgent batches (turn end, ask, status) skip the 100 ms flush wait, so their newest event's age at send is the runner's append + fold + outbox + host hop with no deliberate delay; 50 ms is an eighth of the K3 warm budget (400 ms). The flushed line includes up to 100 ms of intended wait and is context only. Not in production telemetry: the runner's own append and fold time per turn; that cost is measured by CI `npm run perf-check` (turn CPU v3 vs v4 vs v4 with a client), whose gate is the Slack-visible p50, not CPU.

panels.title: Computer DO load (check 1 detail)
DO busy ms per org-minute p95 (batches + writes, chain wait excluded)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(minute) AS time, quantile(0.95)(busy_ms) AS `busy ms per org-minute p95`, max(busy_ms) AS `max` FROM (
  SELECT org_id, toStartOfMinute(occurred_at) AS minute,
    sumIf(greatest(JSONExtractInt(data, 'do_ack_ms') - JSONExtractInt(data, 'do_chain_wait_ms'), 0), event_name = 'sessionlog.append') + sumIf(JSONExtractInt(data, 'do_ms'), event_name = 'computer.write') AS busy_ms
  FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.append', 'computer.write') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE org_id != '' GROUP BY org_id, minute)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Above 30000 ms (half of every minute) one org's DO spends most of its time awaiting journal and write work. Await time, not CPU (see check 1).

panels.title: Where a batch's DO time goes (avg)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, avg(JSONExtractInt(data, 'do_chain_wait_ms')) AS chain_wait, avg(JSONExtractInt(data, 'do_pre_ms')) AS pre, avg(JSONExtractInt(data, 'append_ms')) AS append,
  avg(JSONExtractInt(data, 'do_post_ms')) AS post FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.append') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: chain_wait: behind the session's earlier batches; pre: received → append RPC sent; append: the SessionLog round trip; post: answered → row updated and ack sent.

panels.title: Slack dispatch wait and K1 p95: busy − quiet org-minutes (hourly)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfHour(occurred_at) AS time, if(event_name = 'dispatch.sent', 'Slack dispatch wait p95: busy − quiet (hourly)', 'K1 p95: busy − quiet (hourly)') AS metric,
  if(countIf(busy) > 0 AND countIf(NOT busy) > 0, quantileIf(0.95)(ms, busy) - quantileIf(0.95)(ms, NOT busy), NULL) AS value
FROM (SELECT occurred_at, event_name, if(event_name = 'dispatch.sent', JSONExtractInt(data, 'wait_ms'), toInt64(duration_ms)) AS ms,
  (org_id, toStartOfMinute(occurred_at)) IN (SELECT DISTINCT org_id, toStartOfMinute(occurred_at) FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.append') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE org_id != '') AS busy FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('dispatch.sent', 'ack.done') AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY event_id))
GROUP BY time, metric

panels.title: The DO's Slack queue (max)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, 'rows pending + running' AS metric, max(JSONExtractInt(data, 'slack_queue_rows')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.append', 'computer.write') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE JSONHas(data, 'slack_queue_rows') GROUP BY time, metric
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, 'oldest pending wait (ms)' AS metric, max(JSONExtractInt(data, 'slack_queue_oldest_ms')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.append', 'computer.write') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE JSONHas(data, 'slack_queue_oldest_ms') GROUP BY time, metric
) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Q2 · What the session log costs
SessionLog append latency

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, quantile(0.5)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'append_ms')) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'append_ms')) AS p95, max(JSONExtractInt(data, 'append_ms')) AS max
FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.append') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, 'journal batches' AS metric, count() AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('mirror.batch') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE 1 GROUP BY time, metric
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, 'journal events' AS metric, sum(JSONExtractInt(data, 'events')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('mirror.batch') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE 1 GROUP BY time, metric
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, 'rows written' AS metric, sum(JSONExtractInt(data, 'rows')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.append') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE 1 GROUP BY time, metric
UNION ALL

) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Bytes appended and spilled to R2

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, 'appended' AS metric, sum(JSONExtractInt(data, 'bytes')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.append') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE 1 GROUP BY time, metric
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, 'spilled in the append' AS metric, sum(JSONExtractInt(data, 'spill_sync_bytes')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.append') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE 1 GROUP BY time, metric
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, 'spilled after commit' AS metric, sum(JSONExtractInt(data, 'spill_bytes')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.spill') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE 1 GROUP BY time, metric
) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Per org: batches, bytes, spills, refolds, storage

targets.rawSql:
SELECT org_id, countIf(event_name = 'sessionlog.append') AS appends, sumIf(JSONExtractInt(data, 'events'), event_name = 'sessionlog.append') AS events,
  sumIf(JSONExtractInt(data, 'bytes'), event_name = 'sessionlog.append') AS bytes, quantileIf(0.95)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'append_ms'), event_name = 'sessionlog.append') AS append_p95_ms,
  sumIf(JSONExtractInt(data, 'spills_sync'), event_name = 'sessionlog.append') + sumIf(JSONExtractInt(data, 'spills'), event_name = 'sessionlog.spill') AS spills,
  sumIf(JSONExtractInt(data, 'failed'), event_name = 'sessionlog.spill') AS spills_failed, countIf(JSONExtractBool(data, 'refolded')) AS refolds,
  maxIf(JSONExtractInt(data, 'storage_bytes'), event_name = 'sessionlog.append') AS storage_bytes_max
FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.append', 'sessionlog.spill') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) GROUP BY org_id ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Q3 · How fresh is what clients see
Event age p95 at each hop

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, '1 host sent (oldest in batch)' AS metric, quantile(0.95)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'oldest_age_ms')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('mirror.batch') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE 1 GROUP BY time, metric
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, '2 DO committed (newest acked)' AS metric, quantile(0.95)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'age_ms')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('mirror.ack') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE 1 GROUP BY time, metric
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, '2b blue commit lag (max per append)' AS metric, quantile(0.95)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'commit_lag_ms_max')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.append') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE 1 GROUP BY time, metric
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, '3 API reader (oldest delivered)' AS metric, quantile(0.95)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'oldest_age_ms')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('httpapi.request') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE JSONExtractInt(data, 'events') > 0 GROUP BY time, metric
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, '4 wire socket (oldest written)' AS metric, quantile(0.95)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'oldest_age_ms')) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('wire.flush') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE 1 GROUP BY time, metric
) ORDER BY time

panels.description: Each hop's p95 age of an event (now − its createdAt on the runner). Runner and Cloudflare clocks differ, so blue-side ages carry the skew. The alert fires when the DO-committed or wire-socket p95 is above 2000 ms for 15 min. Per turn: the `freshness` endpoint with `per_turn`.

Requests by layer and status class

FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('edge.request', 'httpapi.request') AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY event_id) GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, concat('edge ', JSONExtractString(data, 'route')) AS metric, quantile(0.95)(duration_ms) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('edge.request') AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE 1 GROUP BY time, metric

panels.title: 503 computer_unavailable, 429s, replays, empty long-polls

SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, '503 (blue)' AS metric, count() AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('httpapi.request') AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE JSONExtractInt(data, 'status') = 503 GROUP BY time, metric
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeInterval(occurred_at) AS time, '429 (edge)' AS metric, count() AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('edge.request') AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE JSONExtractInt(data, 'status') = 429 OR JSONExtractBool(data, 'rate_limited') GROUP BY time, metric
UNION ALL

UNION ALL

) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Outages, auth failures and rate limits by key

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT 'outage: time until the host came' AS what, '' AS detail, count() AS n, quantile(0.5)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'wait_ms')) AS p50_ms, quantile(0.95)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'wait_ms')) AS p95_ms FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('computer.unavailable') AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY event_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'edge auth refused', JSONExtractString(data, 'auth'), count(), NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('edge.request') AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE JSONExtractString(data, 'auth') NOT IN ('ok', '') GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'rate limited key', JSONExtractString(data, 'key_id'), count(), NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('edge.request') AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE JSONExtractInt(data, 'status') = 429 OR JSONExtractBool(data, 'rate_limited') GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'long-poll hold', JSONExtractString(data, 'route'), count(), quantile(0.5)(duration_ms), quantile(0.95)(duration_ms) FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('httpapi.request') AND NOT synthetic LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE JSONExtractInt(data, 'wait_ms') > 0 GROUP BY 2
) ORDER BY what, n DESC

panels.title: Concurrent connections, members, terminals (max per host)

panels.title: Recovery: counts and durations

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT concat('blue ', JSONExtractString(data, 'kind')) AS kind, JSONExtractString(data, 'reason') AS detail, count() AS n, countIf(outcome = 'failed') AS failed, quantile(0.95)(duration_ms) AS p95_ms FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.recovery') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) GROUP BY kind, detail
UNION ALL SELECT 'held write', if(JSONExtractBool(data, 'timed_out'), 'timed out', if(JSONExtractBool(data, 'replayed'), 'replayed', '')), count(), countIf(JSONExtractBool(data, 'timed_out')), quantile(0.95)(JSONExtractInt(data, 'held_ms')) FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('computer.write') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) WHERE JSONExtractBool(data, 'held') OR JSONExtractBool(data, 'timed_out') OR JSONExtractBool(data, 'replayed') GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'epoch adopted', if(JSONExtractBool(data, 'torn'), 'torn', ''), count(), countIf(outcome = 'failed'), quantile(0.95)(duration_ms) FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('api.epoch_adopted') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'frame held', if(JSONExtractBool(data, 'asked'), 'asked for epoch', ''), count(), 0, quantile(0.95)(duration_ms) FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('api.held') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicates', 'append dupes + mismatches', toUInt64(sum(JSONExtractInt(data, 'dupes') + JSONExtractInt(data, 'mismatches'))), 0, NULL FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('sessionlog.append') LIMIT 1 BY event_id)

panels.title: Q9 · Keys and revocation
Key syncs, revokes and refusals after a revoke

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT concat('synced ', JSONExtractString(data, 'trigger')) AS what, count() AS n, countIf(NOT JSONExtractBool(data, 'ok') OR outcome = 'failed') AS failed, quantile(0.95)(duration_ms) AS p95_ms, NULL AS last_after_revoke_ms FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('keys.synced') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) GROUP BY what
UNION ALL SELECT 'revoked', count(), countIf(NOT JSONExtractBool(data, 'host_told')), quantile(0.95)(duration_ms), NULL FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('keys.revoked') LIMIT 1 BY event_id)
UNION ALL SELECT concat('used after revoke (', if(e.event_name = 'edge.request', 'edge', 'wire'), ')'), count(),
  countIf(NOT ((e.event_name = 'edge.request' AND JSONExtractUInt(e.data, 'status') IN (401, 403)) OR (e.event_name = 'wireworker.request' AND JSONExtractString(e.data, 'result') = 'refused'))), NULL,
  max(toInt64(dateDiff('millisecond', r.revoked_at, e.occurred_at)))
FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('edge.request', 'wireworker.request') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) AS e
INNER JOIN (SELECT JSONExtractString(data, 'key_id') AS key_id, min(occurred_at) AS revoked_at FROM (SELECT * FROM calvin_events WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_name IN ('keys.revoked') LIMIT 1 BY event_id) GROUP BY key_id) AS r ON r.key_id = JSONExtractString(e.data, 'key_id')
WHERE e.occurred_at > r.revoked_at GROUP BY 1
) ORDER BY what

panels.description: "used after revoke" counts requests carrying a revoked key; `failed` there counts the ones that were let through (should be 0). Revoke → last socket closed is not measurable: wire.close has no key_id.
